_comment: MySeliaSan distribution defaults — the fleet control plane for MyMataSan nodes. Safe to edit. On first run a strong jwt.secret is generated and saved here, a self-signed TLS certificate is generated into ./certs (so the app serves HTTPS on :3002 immediately — browsers show a one-time trust warning on a LAN), and a one-time superadmin password is generated and written to INITIAL_ADMIN_LOGIN.txt in the data dir. This file lives in the app's data dir; runtime changes made in the UI are persisted back to it. BEFORE ADOPTING NODES set pairing.parentBaseUrl to a LAN-reachable URL for this host — nodes store it and dial back to it, so 'localhost' will silently break adoption from another machine.

sso._comment: Optional federated login via a MyIDSan instance. Leave providerBaseUrl empty to run on local accounts only — the 'Continue with myidsan' button is then hidden and everyone signs in with the local superadmin. caCertPath may stay empty to trust the system roots.

localAuth._comment: An empty password makes the first run generate a strong per-install one (printed to the log and saved to INITIAL_ADMIN_LOGIN.txt). Set LOCAL_ADMIN_PASSWORD to override. Never ship a shared default here.

pairing._comment: These ports MUST match what the MyMataSan nodes use (their shipped defaults are the 3953x range below). parentBaseUrl is what adopted nodes dial back to — set it to this host's LAN address, e.g. https://192.168.1.10:3002.

securityHeaders.contentSecurityPolicy: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; font-src 'self'; img-src 'self' data: blob:; media-src 'self' blob: mediastream:; connect-src 'self'; worker-src 'self' blob:; frame-src 'self' blob:; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'self'; form-action 'self'; frame-ancestors 'none'
